docs: Collections content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of collections (categories), each a picture and a name as one link. One object is valid in every collections layout (two, three or four columns).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the collections, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the picture of the collection; none: the placeholder
